Progressive Lenses

Progressive lenses in Garden Grove

Progressive lenses let you see far, at arm's length and up close through one pair of glasses, without the visible line of old-style bifocals. How comfortable they feel depends less on the brand name and more on how precisely they are measured and fitted — which is the part we take personally.

Call (714) 530-6700 Directions

What we offer

  • Precise pupil distance and fitting-height measurements taken in the frame you choose
  • Standard, premium and wide-corridor designs (Essilor Varilux, ZEISS, HOYA)
  • Computer / office progressives for long days at a screen
  • Thinner high-index materials for stronger prescriptions
  • Free follow-up adjustments while you get used to them

Good to know

Most people adapt to progressives within one to two weeks. If you still struggle after that, come back — a small change to the frame fit often solves it, and we will check the measurements again before anything else.

Progressive Lenses: common questions

How long does it take to get progressive lenses?

Many progressives are finished in our in-store lab in about 3 business days. Some premium designs are made by the lens manufacturer and can take longer; we give you the expected date when you order.

Can I use my vision insurance for progressives?

Usually yes. Most vision plans cover a standard progressive and apply a set amount toward premium designs. Bring your insurance information and we will show you exactly what is covered before you decide.

Do I need a new prescription?

You need a current prescription that includes an ADD (reading) power. Prescriptions from any eye doctor are welcome.
